lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-parallel vertical columns across the lateral flank, transitioning to a higher-density, smaller-diameter distribution on the visible pectoral fin surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.
